spans.s: चैतन्य n. 1. Spirit, life, vitality; 2. the supreme spirit considered as the essence of all being and source of all sensation (in Vedānta phil.).
चैत्य m.n. 1. A pile of stones forming a boundary; 2. a monument, a tomb-stone; 3. a sacrificial shed; 4. a temple; 5. a Bauddha or Jaina temple; 6. the religious fig tree. See Megh.i.23.
चैत्य-तरु, -द्रुम, -वृक्ष m. a fig tree standing on a sacred spot.

चैत्य-पाल m. the guardian of a sanctuary.
चैत्र (I) m. 1. Name of a lunar month in which the fall moon stands in the constellation Chitrā; 2. a Buddhist mendicant.
चैत्र-आवलि f. ths full moon day of Chaitra.
चैत्र-सख m. an epithet of tha god of love.
चैत्ररथ(थ्य) n. Name of the garden of Kubera, एको ययौ चैत्ररथप्रदेशान् सौराज्यरम्यानपरो विदर्भान् R.v.60.
